name: How long does a typical window repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical window repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a window repair varies significantly depending on the type and extent of the damage. A simple glass replacement might take a few hours, while more complex repairs involving frame work or custom-ordered parts could take longer, potentially spanning a day or requiring a follow-up visit. When ordering custom glass or specific hardware, lead times can impact the overall timeline. We provide an estimated timeframe after our initial assessment to manage expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time depends on damage complexity; simple glass replacement takes hours, while custom parts or extensive frame work can take longer due to lead times.
